chunks.text: YOU EVER GET TOLD YOU'RE NOTHING SO MANY TIMES
LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT THE DAY I STOPPED
I'LL FIND YOU IN EVERY LIFE / EVERY LIFE
THROUGH THE GATES AND THROUGH THE AGES
THROUGH THE DARKNESS AND THE LIGHT
AND NOT THE MONARCH ON THE THRONE
WEAKEST HUNTER ON THE PLANET YEAH
THEY STAMPED IT ON MY FILE
I'M BARELY LEAVING WITH A SMILE
I'M THE GUY WHO TAKES THE HIT
SO THE REAL HUNTERS DON'T BLEED
WATCHED THE ONES I TRUSTED RUN
AND LEAVE ME THERE TO DIE ALONE
SYSTEM POPPED UP PLAYER YOU ACCEPT?
WHAT ELSE I'M SUPPOSED TO DO?
WENT FROM PUNCHING BAG TO PUNCHING
HERE'S THE THING THAT NOBODY TELLS YOU
BRO YOUR LONELINESS JUST LEVELS TOO
GOT A LEGION IN MY SHADOW
AND A SILENCE IN MY CHEST
THEN SHE WALKED INTO THE GUILD
AND MAN I NEVER BEEN SO STRESSED
FROM THE SHADOWS THAT I OWN
I'VE GOT AN ARMY OF THE DEAD
BUT I DON'T WANNA BE ALONE
AND NOT THE MONARCH ON THE THRONE
CHECK IT EVERY HUNTER STINKS TO HER
THAT'S THE CURSE SHE LIVES WITH
SO SHE KEEPS HER DISTANCE RIGID
AND HOLD UP LEANS IN CLOSE?
SHE SAID AND I'M LIKE IS
FIRST TIME SOMEBODY LOOKED AT ME
LIKE THE BEST THING THEY EVER HAD
BLEEDING BLADE UP STILL REFUSING STOPPING
AND I DROP DOWN FROM THE CLOUDS
WITH THE DEAD RISING BEHIND ME
EYE TO EYE THROUGH THE CARNAGE
AND I SWEAR THE WAR WENT QUIET
LIKE SOMEBODY PAUSED THE APOCALYPSE JUST
SO I COULD TRY IT TRY
FOR ONE SECOND NOT A WEAPON
NOT THE MONARCH NOT THE NIGHTMARE
WHO TALKS TO SHADOWS FIGHTS WITH GODS
AND NEVER LEARNED HOW TO EXIST
FROM THE SHADOWS THAT I OWN
I'VE GOT AN ARMY OF THE DEAD
BUT I DON'T WANNA BE ALONE
DOWN THE RULERS AND THE MONARCHS
WIPE THE SLATE DON'T LOOK BACK
NO GATES NO SYSTEM NO REWARD
SHE'S A STRANGER ON A SIDEWALK
I'M A GHOST THAT SHE IGNORES
I GAVE UP THE WORLD REMEMBERING
A THOUSAND TIMES BUT NEVER COULD RETRACE
HAVE WE MET BEFORE? SHE SAYS
AND I CAN BARELY EVEN TALK
I SWALLOW HARD I SMILE I SAY
NOT YET BUT I'VE GOT TIME
I NEVER FINISHED WAS THE ONE
THEY CAN TAKE THE LEVELS THE SHADOWS THE THRONE
ERASE MY NAME FROM EVERY BOOK
BUT THE WAY SHE LOOKED AT ME ON JEJU?
THAT'S NOT A MEMORY THAT'S A SAVE FILE
AND I'M LOADING IT EVERY SINGLE LIFE
I'LL FIND YOU IN EVERY LIFE / EVERY LIFE
THROUGH THE GATES AND THROUGH THE AGES
THROUGH THE DARKNESS AND THE LIGHT
AND NOT THE MONARCH ON THE THRONE
NOT THE MONARCH / NOT THE MONARCH
A PLACE TO CALL THEIR HOME
TURNS OUT THE STRONGEST THING I EVER DID
